_comment: Editorial content for HUSI. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. Deliberately no product list: the company discontinued textile operations in 2014 and reports itself in real estate, so listing its former textile lines would misdescribe what it does.
description: Husein Industries Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 25 May 1953 as Husein Textile Mills Limited and renamed Husein Industries Limited in 1964. It discontinued textile operations in the financial year 2014 and then diversified into real estate development and construction, including residential plots and commercial sites; shareholders and regulators approved the change to its objects in the years ended 30 June 2018 and 30 June 2019.
headOffice: HT-8, Landhi Industrial & Trading Estate, Landhi, Karachi 75120, Pakistan
sourceNote: PSX Data Portal company record for HUSI (business description, key people, address) and the company's contact page at husein.com, read 2026-10-17.
